design_origin: Reviewer-driven correction for path dependence. This is not claimed as preregistered before the existing cross-generator results.
research_question: How much of the fixed-target Macro-F1 change is assigned to training-side channel, generator-family and parameter-distribution matching after averaging the marginal contribution over all six factor orders, and how large are factor interactions and order sensitivity?
scope: Simulation-only attribution audit on the existing continuous/sparse analytic generator family. It is neither physical validation nor an order-free causal decomposition of real radar performance.

source_lock.artifact_rule: Each seed NPZ and model artifact must match the per-run SHA-256 recorded in the locked source results.

channel_matching.zero: training observations at fp=0 GHz, condition index 0
channel_matching.one: training observations at fp=9.5 GHz, condition index 1, matching the fixed target channel

generator_matching.one: sparse point-scatterer blade generator, matching the fixed target generator

parameter_matching.zero: source ranges: rotation 60-100 Hz, blade length 0.05-0.10 m, beta 30-70 deg
parameter_matching.one: joint-holdout target ranges: rotation 105-120 Hz, blade length 0.105-0.120 m, beta 75-90 deg

seed_rules.fixed_test_latent_seed: 110000 + seed, inherited from the locked source result
seed_rules.fixed_test_scatter_seed: 240000 + seed, inherited from the locked source result
seed_rules.model_initialization_seed: seed, identical across all eight corners within a run

sample_budget.independent_inference_units: six synthetic seeds; corners, factors, paths and test predictions are paired within seed

fixed_target.source_array: test__joint_holdout__sparse_raw[1] and test__joint_holdout__y from each locked data/cross_generator/seed_{seed}.npz
fixed_target.reuse_rule: Exactly the same target feature matrix and labels are used for every corner and must not enter fitting, scaling or model selection.

strictly_paired_training_library.p0_source: Load continuous_source__continuous_raw, continuous_source__sparse_raw, continuous_source__latent, continuous_source__noise_raw, continuous_source__scatter_positions_fraction, continuous_source__scatter_weights, continuous_source__scatter_active and continuous_source__y from the locked per-seed NPZ.
strictly_paired_training_library.p1_generation: Call generate_paired_generator_bank with n_per_class=200, seed=90000+seed, scatter_seed=220000+seed, the locked cross-generator configuration and the joint-holdout ranges.
pairing_invariants: p0 and p1 labels and record order are exactly equal
blade count, alpha, distance and phase latent columns are exactly equal
rotation, length and beta normalized quantiles under their declared ranges agree within 1e-12
noise_raw agrees within 1e-12 and the p1 full complex-noise SHA-256 equals the recorded p0 continuous_source noise SHA-256
sparse scatter positions, weights and active masks are exactly equal
all C and G corners are selected from the paired arrays without regeneration or resampling

model.preprocessing: Per-corner seven-feature mean and standard deviation fitted on that corner's training data only, using fit_baseline. No tuning, early stopping or test-conditioned selection.
model.secondary_models: Not part of v1. Existing SVM and RF results remain descriptive. Any future full-factor secondary analysis requires a new frozen protocol version.

metric.primary: Macro-F1 on the fixed sparse 9.5-GHz joint-holdout test bank
metric.corner_value_symbol: v_cgp, computed separately for each seed

attribution.path_reporting: For each seed, retain the three stepwise marginal contributions under every path. Report each factor's six path means, Shapley mean, minimum, maximum and range.

uncertainty.bootstrap_type: paired nonparametric cluster bootstrap over complete seed blocks
uncertainty.resampling_rule: Sample six seed IDs with replacement. For each sampled block retain all eight corner values and recompute all path marginals, Shapley values, interactions and total gain before averaging.
uncertainty.additional_reporting: Report all six raw seed values and Student-t 95% intervals for compatibility. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive and exclude physical-model uncertainty.
uncertainty.multiplicity: No familywise discovery claim. The three Shapley intervals and interaction intervals are reported jointly and descriptively; no result-driven factor selection.

predeclared_interpretation_lines.direction_stable_rule: All six path-order mean marginals have the same sign and at least five of six per-seed Shapley values have that sign.
predeclared_interpretation_lines.resolved_direction_rule: The paired seed-bootstrap 95% interval for the mean Shapley value excludes zero. This is descriptive for the synthetic protocol, not a universal significance claim.

acceptance.claim_rule: Favorable signs are not an execution acceptance criterion. If order-stability or legacy-path closeness fails, replace the original independent-error-source wording with path-dependent staged gaps and report Shapley plus interactions.

smoke_test.data_rule: Generate both P0 and P1 paired banks and a separate fixed target bank at smoke size. Do not subset the locked full-size banks.
smoke_test.purpose: Execution and verifier check only; no scientific inference.

expected_cost.basis: The locked cross-generator run required about 79-91 seconds per seed while generating several banks and fitting three model families. This protocol reuses P0 and target banks, generates one P1 bank and fits eight MLPs per seed.
expected_cost.estimated_wall_time: approximately 3-6 minutes for six seeds plus independent replay verification on the current host
expected_cost.estimated_peak_memory: below 0.5 GB when the generated full time-domain noise is hashed and discarded before fitting
expected_cost.estimated_new_disk: below 15 MB when only paired features, predictions, models, summaries and hashes are saved

failure_and_downgrade: A smoke-test integrity failure blocks the formal run. Fix the implementation, increment the protocol version if semantics change, and do not silently retry.
A pairing, source-hash, replay, nonfinite or Shapley-identity failure marks the formal run failed. Preserve the partial directory and do not overwrite it.
If abs(v111-v000) is below 0.05, relative attribution and order-range ratios are undefined; report absolute effects only.
If any factor fails direction or order-stability lines, retain all values and downgrade the manuscript to path-dependent staged gaps. Do not tune seeds, models, ranges or thresholds.
If an interval crosses zero, report the factor direction as unresolved in this synthetic sample. Do not add seeds after inspecting results under this protocol.
No measured, CST, physical-plasma or real-radar claim may be introduced regardless of numerical outcome.
stopping_rule: After a verified smoke test, run all six frozen seeds and all eight corners exactly once. Preserve negative and nonmonotonic effects. No performance-driven tuning, corner removal, seed replacement, early stopping or post-hoc threshold change.
